excerpt: The Amazon Chime SDK is a set of real-time communications components that you can use to quickly add messaging, audio, video, and screen sharing capabilities to your web or mobile applications.
You can choose to implement some or all of the available media modalities (audio, video, and screen share) for a single rate.
Each attendee can publish one video source, up to a total of 25 simultaneous videos per meeting.
Clients with bandwidth constraints automatically subscribe to the lower bitrate stream.
We use the Opus codec to encode audio, with a default bitrate of 32kbps, which can be increased to up to 128kbps stereo and 64kbps mono.
In addition to audio and video content, meeting attendees can send each other real-time data messages of up to 2 KB each.
You can use messages to implement custom meeting features such as whiteboarding, chat, real-time emoji reactions, and application-specific floor control signaling.
The client application can share audio and video content, such as screen captures or media files.
Video encoding and decoding uses hardware acceleration where available to improve performance.
Create a meeting session in your client application.
Create a messaging session in your client application to receive messages from Amazon Chime SDK for Messaging.
